verdict.rationale: Docs show gateway-managed API keys belong to a Vercel team and work across environments, with per-key budgets, per-key spend/usage summaries, and centralized credential management—so teams/apps use gateway keys instead of raw provider keys (docs-40, docs-16, docs-12, docs-32). OIDC token support further removes the need to manage provider secrets in Vercel deployments (docs-14/22). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-app/per-team key scoping or permission granularity, and key rotation/revocation workflows.
